column1: # The inputs of the CPU suite (.github/workflows/cpu_suite.yml), each checked against its SHA-256 before use.
# item: a cache entry (the reference tags as tests/CMakeLists.txt names them; "common" is what every job needs).
# source: release:<tag> (an asset of Xassemblianist/cppmpas-data), parts:<tag> (the joined <file>.part* assets of
# that release; the SHA-256 is that of the joined archive, docs/REFERENCES.md), url:<address>.
# The rrtmg tables are CPPWRF data/rrtmg at the commit in the address (CPPMPAS_CPPWRF_RRTMG).
